title: Australian Citizenship Amendment (Special Residence Requirements) Bill 2013

speeches.speaker: Brendan O'Connor
speeches.brief: Moved the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Special Residence Requirements) Bill 2013, reporting that since September 2009 the existing special residence provisions had been used 14 times under section 22A and 84 times under section 22B, and detailed a new alternative residence test requiring 180 days' presence in Australia during the prior two years and a commitment to spend at least 180 days in Australia during the two years after gaining citizenship.

speeches.speaker: Scott Morrison
speeches.brief: Supported the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Special Residence Requirements) Bill 2013, which gives the minister discretion to grant citizenship to permanent residents of at least 90 days in exceptional national-interest cases such as elite athletes, scientists or executives who cannot meet the standard four-year residence requirement, while requiring the minister to table a statement in parliament within 15 sitting days of each use of the power.

speeches.speaker: Steve Georganas
speeches.brief: Supported the citizenship bill, citing his constituent Cesare Lastella, an Italian-born chief executive who has lived in Australia since the late seventies but could not gain citizenship due to frequent overseas travel for work, and detailed the bill's alternative residence test requiring 180 days' presence in the prior two years and 90 days as a permanent resident immediately beforehand.

speeches.speaker: Sharon Bird
speeches.brief: Summed up the debate on the citizenship bill, explaining it gives the minister discretion for a very small number of exceptional cases where reduced residence would benefit Australia, requires applicants to still meet identity, character and testing requirements, and allows the minister to revoke citizenship if recipients fail to honour their undertaking to spend time in Australia afterward.

speeches.speaker: Michaelia Cash
speeches.brief: The coalition supported the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Special Residence Requirements) Bill 2013, which gives the immigration minister discretion to grant citizenship with reduced residency in exceptional national interest cases, requiring parliamentary disclosure of reasons, and covering sporting, cultural, scientific and business fields.

acts.title: Australian Citizenship Amendment (Special Residence Requirements) Act 2013
